question: Which single ritual element is claimed to bear the names vedikā, neck, head, and vasu-corner together?
premises: that same element is named vedikā
that same element is named neck
that same element is named head
that same element is named vasu-corner
inference: One identified form carries all these named parts in this ritual description.
uncertainties: Exact ritual referent of vedikā and vasukoṇaka in this passage is not specified here
plain_english: That same thing is called the vedikā, and it is also called the neck, the head, and the vasu-corner.
